Apply the explicit human offline campaign revision recorded in docs/reports/M9-robustness/offline-decision.json; campaign/harness execution remains offline/unrun and nonblocking, while dedicated timing and confirmed defects remain mandatory. Apply the direct human dedicated-timing deferral in docs/reports/M9-performance/timing-decision.json; local timings are informational, with no original timing-target passes. Memory/allocation requirements are unchanged. Apply separate direct human acceptance of current approximately0.90xBCL retained-memory budget in docs/reports/M9-performance/memory-decision.json; retain original0.75target without pass credit.

Repeat affected acceptance checks on exact package revision; document exceptions and outstanding exclusions; publication remains separate. Record offline campaign execution separately from actual passing checks; no original sustained-duration or crash-positive pass is implied.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.
